adverse_boundary: Both individual adverse pairs remain in their condition medians. Improvement in every individual run is not established.
aggregate_definition: Inverse of the equally weighted geometric mean of six condition median paired ratios; not a ratio of pooled elapsed seconds.
interpretation: Installed API search-only, pure Python3.11.8 on nonexclusive shared Windows host. No imports/process/setup/receipt costs or compiled/CLI/parallel/general-machine quality claim.
public_release_acceptance: Separate repository, CI and affected installed-public-consumer gates are required.
scope_limits: search-only installed pure-Python API on the declared nonexclusive Windows host
no decision-quality, default, reward, objective or full-encounter improvement claim
no CLI acquisition/startup throughput, compiled or parallel-speed claim
Python tracemalloc peak is not RSS, committed memory, allocation volume or cold-start memory
